title: Machine learning and single-cell RNA sequencing reveal relationship between intratumor CD8 + T cells and uveal melanoma metastasis.
summary: TCGA-UVM analyses linked intratumoral CD8+ T-cell profiles and three genes to metastasis and survival; retrospective data and internal modeling do not establish causality or external validity. The finding is bounded to the reported study and does not establish causal benefit or generalization.
